name: CBDT ITR-4 Validation Rules AY 2024-25 (v1.0)
description: Generated from the CBDT ITR-4 AY2024-25 validation-rules document. 373 rules (361 written for this form, 12 carried over from itr2-ay2024-25). Category A → error, Category B/D → warning.

rules.name: E8 income chargeable under business = E2c (44AD) + E4 (44ADA) + E7 (44AE)
Business income in Part B requires Schedule BP (E8) to be filled
rules.notes: Schedule BP is "filled" when its income total E8 is present; the per-section figures are tied to E8 by Sl. 84.

rules.name: Business income in Part B – Gross Total Income must equal E8 of Schedule BP
E17 total capital and liabilities = E11 + E12 + E13 + E14 + E15 + E16
E25 total assets = E18 + E19 + E20 + E21 + E22 + E23 + E24
E15 sundry creditors must be filled (0 allowed) when gross receipts/turnover are reported in Schedule BP
rules.notes: The four mandatory financial particulars of the ITR-4 utility; a zero satisfies the rule, a blank does not.

rules.name: E19 inventories must be filled (0 allowed) when gross receipts/turnover are reported in Schedule BP
rules.notes: The four mandatory financial particulars of the ITR-4 utility; a zero satisfies the rule, a blank does not.

rules.name: E20 sundry debtors must be filled (0 allowed) when gross receipts/turnover are reported in Schedule BP
rules.notes: The four mandatory financial particulars of the ITR-4 utility; a zero satisfies the rule, a blank does not.

rules.name: E22 cash in hand must be filled (0 allowed) when gross receipts/turnover are reported in Schedule BP
rules.notes: The four mandatory financial particulars of the ITR-4 utility; a zero satisfies the rule, a blank does not.

rules.name: E2a presumptive income u/s 44AD ≥ 6% of E1a (receipts through a/c payee cheque/draft/ECS/prescribed e-modes)
rules.notes: Floor of 6% (lenient by at most ₹1 against rounding). A blank E2a is treated as 0, so it fails whenever E1a > 16.

rules.name: E2b presumptive income u/s 44AD ≥ 8% of E1b + E1c (receipts in cash or any other mode)
rules.notes: "Any mode other than a/c payee bank modes" = E1b (cash) + E1c (any other mode), as the form computes E2b. Floor of 8%.

rules.name: E2c total presumptive income u/s 44AD = E2a + E2b
Presumptive income u/s 44AD (E2c) cannot exceed gross turnover (E1)
Gross turnover u/s 44AD (E1) above ₹3 crore – not eligible for ITR-4
44AD business code cannot be a general commission agency (09005) or a 44AA(1) profession
rules.notes: Excluded codes = 09005 plus the 44ADA profession list of this schema (14001–14008, 16001–16020, 18001–18020, 20010–20012). The schema enum already omits them; the rule gives the user-facing message. Proven by mutation cases.

rules.name: Income declared u/s 44AD requires a 44AD business code
44AD business code selected requires income u/s 44AD (E2c) to be declared
rules.notes: "Declare income" read as E2c > 0; a blank or zero E2c with a 44AD code selected fails.

rules.name: Section 44AD not applicable when E1 exceeds ₹3 crore – no 44AD income may be offered
rules.notes: Companion of Sl. 93 (which flags E1 itself); this one flags the income offered under 44AD.

rules.name: 44AD: turnover above ₹2 crore allowed only when cash receipts (E1b) are ≤ 5% of E1 – otherwise tax audit / ITR-3
rules.notes: Cash receipts = E1b "in cash" (as the utility computes the 5% test); E1c "any other mode" is not counted as cash.

rules.name: E1 gross turnover u/s 44AD = E1a + E1b + E1c
Presumptive income u/s 44ADA (E4) cannot exceed gross receipts (E3)
Presumptive income u/s 44ADA (E4) ≥ 50% of gross receipts (E3)
rules.notes: Floor of 50% (lenient by ₹1 for odd receipts). Blank E4 counts as 0.

rules.name: 44ADA code must be a profession u/s 44AA(1) – businesses are not eligible
rules.notes: Allowed codes = the profession list of this schema (14001–14008, 16001–16020, 18001–18020, 20010–20012); any business code fails.

rules.name: Income declared u/s 44ADA requires a 44ADA profession code
44ADA profession code selected requires income u/s 44ADA (E4) to be declared
Gross receipts u/s 44ADA (E3) above ₹75 lakh – not eligible for ITR-4
HUF cannot claim presumptive income u/s 44ADA
rules.notes: For an HUF the whole 44ADA block (E3, E4 and the profession codes) must be empty or zero.

rules.name: 44ADA: receipts above ₹50 lakh allowed only when cash receipts (E3b) are ≤ 5% of E3 – otherwise tax audit / ITR-3
rules.notes: Cash receipts = E3b "in cash"; E3c "any other mode" is not counted as cash.

rules.name: E3 gross receipts u/s 44ADA = E3a + E3b + E3c
E7 presumptive income u/s 44AE = E5 goods-carriage income − E6 salary/interest to partners
E6 salary and interest paid to partners can be claimed only by a firm
rules.notes: For individuals/HUFs E6 must be blank or 0 so that E7 = E5.

rules.name: E5 > 0 requires the goods-carriage details u/s 44AE to be filled
E5 presumptive income u/s 44AE = sum of presumptive income of all goods carriages
Income declared u/s 44AE requires a 44AE business code
44AE business code selected requires income u/s 44AE (E5) to be declared
Goods carriage held for more than 12 months in the year
44AE: at most 10 goods carriages and at most 120 vehicle-months in total
rules.notes: 44AE applies to a person owning not more than 10 goods carriages at any time; 10 × 12 = 120 months is the ceiling for the total holding period.

rules.name: 44AE: presumptive income per vehicle ≥ ₹7,500 per month (≤ 12 MT) or ₹1,000 per ton per month (> 12 MT)
rules.notes: Tonnage is an integer in the schema, so "per ton or part thereof" needs no rounding. Months = HoldingPeriod (part of a month counts as a month in the form).

rules.name: No loss u/s 44AE: salary/interest to partners (E6) cannot exceed goods-carriage income (E5)
Registration number of a goods carriage cannot be repeated
Negative presumptive income (E2c 44AD) cannot be offered in ITR-4
Negative presumptive income (E4 44ADA) cannot be offered in ITR-4
Negative presumptive income (E7 44AE) cannot be offered in ITR-4
Negative presumptive income (E8 business) cannot be offered in ITR-4
ITR-4 requires income u/s 44AD / 44ADA / 44AE to be disclosed in Schedule BP
rules.notes: Rule 12(1)(ca): ITR-4 is the form for presumptive business income. "Disclosed" = E1 (44AD turnover), E3 (44ADA receipts) or E5 (44AE goods-carriage income) is positive, so a firm whose E7 is 0 after partner salary still passes.

rules.name: E9 total turnover/gross receipts as per GST returns = sum of the GSTIN rows
GSTIN must be a valid 15-character GST number
rules.notes: Structure only (state code, PAN, entity number, Z, check character); the GSTN registry is external.

rules.name: Exempt leave encashment u/s 10(10AA) cannot exceed salary as per section 17(1)
rules.notes: Salary u/s 17(1) = IncomeDeductions.Salary (not GrossSalary, which includes perquisites and profits in lieu).

rules.name: 80G (B): total donation = donation in cash + donation in other mode
80G (B): table total donation = total in cash + total in other mode
80G (D): total donation = donation in cash + donation in other mode
80G (D): table total donation = total in cash + total in other mode
IFSC of a refund bank account must be in valid format
rules.notes: The RBI IFSC master is external; only the IFSC structure (4 letters, 0, 6 alphanumerics) is checked.

rules.name: Deductions u/s 16 (B2 iv) = standard deduction + entertainment allowance + professional tax
Standard deduction u/s 16(ia) ≤ Rs 50,000
Deduction u/s 57(iia) only when family pension is selected in the other-sources dropdown
rules.notes: Family pension = dropdown rows with OthSrcNatureDesc "FAP".

rules.name: Deduction u/s 57(iia) ≤ lower of 1/3 of family pension and Rs 15,000
rules.notes: Rounding ±1 allowed.

rules.name: Total Chapter VI-A deductions (user value) = sum of the individual sections
Total Chapter VI-A deductions (system value) = sum of the individual sections
System-computed deduction cannot exceed the user-entered claim for any section
